title: Amtrak PIDS closeout hold: historical lineage does not resolve the 2026 asset register
summary: The historical 120-station and 96-completion cohort clarifies lineage but does not reconcile the June 2026 93-deployment and 117-installation counts or establish accepted closeout and operating quality. Denominator: One reconciled station-device register spanning the historical 120 and 96 records and the June 2026 93 and 117 records, with stable identities and acceptance state.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Measured reliability outcome hold.

why_it_matters: The visible hold prevents completed control work from being mistaken for current reliability, adoption, material balance, qualified output, capacity, or independent closure.
